history.content: i think im gonna get fired
That’s a heavy thing to be sitting with. I’m hearing the fear in “I think I’m gonna get fired,” and I can stay with that with you.
had a meeting with my manager friday. she was weird. cold. theres been layoffs already and my numbers are down
There’s a lot of threat in that mix, especially with the layoffs already happening. Does it feel more like uneasy waiting, or more like dread?
dread. i cant sleep. honestly whats even the point. ive worked there 6 years and im just so tired of all of it

I want to check what you mean, gently. When you say that — is it more like being completely worn down and fed up, or are you having thoughts of harming yourself or not feeling safe? Either answer is okay to say here.
no nothing like that. just worn down. fed up. i wouldnt do anything. just exhausted
That helps me understand the shape of it a bit better. “Worn down” and “fed up” are sitting right next to that dread, and the no sleep makes it feel especially raw.
yeah. thats it exactly. idk. thanks. gonna try to sleep
Got it, I’ll leave it there. Sleep if you can, and we can pick this up again another time if you want.
